newsitem.title: FRANCE: CanalSatellite sees 500,000 digital users end '97.
newsitem.headline: CanalSatellite sees 500,000 digital users end '97.

text.p: CanalSatellite aims to have 500,000 subscribers to its digital television service by the end of 1997, and 650,000 subscribers overall by then, its chairman, Bruno Delecour, says.

He told an analysts meeting on Thursday the 1996 results of Canalsatellite's parent, pay television company Canal Plus, that by the end of this month there would be some 500,000 Canalsatellite subscribers, of whom 300,000 would be subscribers to the digital service.
At the end of last year Canalsatellite had 446,000 subscribers, of whom 203,000 were subscribers to the digital service.
Canal Plus itself aims to reach 4.3 million subscribers in France by the end of the year, up from 4.2 million at end-1996, Canal Plus finance director Laurent Perpere told the meeting.
At end-March it will have a little over 4.21 million subscribers in France, he said.
Abroad, its channels counted 3.2 million subscribers at the end of last year, up from 2.6 million a year earlier.
The strongest growth came in Germany, Poland and Spain, he said, adding that Canal Plus has the lowest rate of contract cancellation among European pay TV companies.
